thread:
kevin: Dropping a fresh skinny-list mock for the routing rules editor. Goal: show 10 rules on a 1280 canvas with compact meta and still surface errors. screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/skinny-list.png
hana: nice layout. two concerns: the drag affordance is pretty subtle and the error copy is long for a compact row.
lucy: agree. for drag, can we add a ghost handle area (30px) and highlight the whole row on hover? makes it easier on touchpads.
raj: keyboard accessibility: we should support move-up/move-down with a single keystroke and announce the new rank via live region, e.g., "Rule 3 of 10".
kevin: good call on live region. also thinking of a tiny rank chip left of the title that flips to a drag icon on hover. minimal footprint.
hana: microcopy: shorten validation to a one-line summary like "missing header rule" and then a chevron to expand full message in the preview drawer. avoid ellipses.
lucy: visual contrast: the compact error badge currently fails small-text AA. propose swapping to token danger-600 bg + white text. aria-label should include "validation error" for screen readers.
aria-ai: accessibility check: ensure the collapse/expand control is reachable in tab order before the details, and keep aria-expanded true/false on the header. do not remove the header from DOM during collapse.
raj: implementation note: lazy-load the full simulation trace only when preview expanded. include a lightweight skeleton so users know the trace is loading.
kevin: on copy for simulation CTA, debating "Run Preview" vs "Simulate Traffic". which reads clearer?
hana: "Simulate Traffic" is more explicit. "Run Preview" feels vague. prefer traffic wording.
lucy: A/B test recommended. small lab: conversion on first-click + clarity survey.
kevin: test plan: 1) drag target size on 1280 and 1024, 2) keyboard reorder with live region, 3) compact error discoverability, 4) contrast audit, 5) CTA copy A/B. i'll iterate the mock and post v2 by tomorrow morning.
hana: will pair on live region phrasing. thanks!
